svg.text: BLITIMAGE: THREE STIPPLE MASKS OF THE PIXELS KEPT (DARK), 12 BY 6 PIXELS SHOWN
every third pixel of every third
In PlayWtrdpScene the full picture is
buffer. The scene draws sprites[0] to
[3] in turn, 3 ticks apart: a picture that
fades in from dots with no palette
DRAWGRID: 16 LINES PAINT EVERY ROW AND COLUMN (COLOUR 12), 8 PIXELS APART, IN TWO PASSES
Steps 0 to 15. xN: vertical lines at x = N, N+8, ... (odd line numbers); yN: horizontal lines at y = N, N+8, ... (even line numbers). Each full-width
horizontal line alone covers its rows, so the eight y steps already fill the screen.
After step 15 every pixel is colour 12, the colour the scenes also use to clear areas (gFillRect with 0Ch), so the routine is a wipe to a flat
colour that is drawn as a growing grid. Dissolve is the other wipe: two shuffled permutations (320 columns, 200 rows) and a copy of every
pixel from one page to another through GetPixel and PutPixel.
